questions.explanation: The given equation is a Bernoulli equation. Rewrite it as dP/dt − k₁P = −k₂P². Substitute v = P^(−1) ⇒ dv/dt = −P^(−2)(dP/dt). The equation becomes dv/dt + k₁v = k₂, which is linear. The integrating factor is e^(∫k₁ dt) = e^(k₁t). Solving gives v = (k₂/k₁) + Ce^(−k₁t) ⇒ P = 1/v = (k₁)/(k₂ + Ce^(−k₁t)).
